millsEvidence.findings: Screenshot shows Request complete, retained in-flight reload draft, enabled Send and send_failed. Browser records no HTTP errors. Failure SQL contains 96 canonical events and 10 started turns; the last user message is close and return, with no subsequent phone in-flight reload admission.
millsEvidence.hostTrigger: Mills uses HandrailAssistantLauncher presentation=page, visible=active and an inline uploaderForConversation. Visibility rerenders replace the upload owner; the composer lifecycle effect resets local sending state while the account-owned ApplicationConversationSession continues its prior submission.
millsEvidence.boundaryLimit: The original Mills artifact did not capture the underlying exception. The SDK fixture reproduces its exact public configuration and symptom and captures pending_send_exists. The full Mills app was not modified or rerun here.

rootCause.send: Session completion observation and display polling are independent. Display controls can report activeTurnId=null before the previous submission promise settles. A remounted or reinitialized composer loses its local isSending flag, exposes Send and rejects in ApplicationConversationSession.sendMessage with pending_send_exists before admission.
rootCause.stop: Explicit Stop after durable admission but before the active turn appears in display controls had no turn ID. The composer recorded a request after its one acceptance callback had already run, so it never dispatched cancellation. stop-before.log holds display controls to reproduce active=null/submitting=true deterministically.
rootCause.fix: Subscribe composer eligibility to the existing shared session snapshot: initialized ready history/controls, no submitting operation and no saved pending submission. Apply the same live check to Send, Enter/form and after asynchronous composer preparation. Retain the accepted turn ID for an explicit Stop before display catches up.
rootCause.scope: Only production file changed: src/react/use-conversation-composer.ts. No timing sleeps, automatic new-message retries, admission-lock weakening, server changes or host workaround.
